title: Do You Know These 5 Feelings in English? #shorts
description:
Do you know these five feelings in English?
• Nervous: a student before an exam
• Proud: a parent at a graduation
• Jealous: a dog watching another dog get a treat
• Relieved: finding your keys in your pocket
• Embarrassed: calling your teacher Mum

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.
